lifecycle_evidence: BIS Product Manual PM/IS 14220/3 (July 2024) confirms IS 14220:2018 (First Revision) as the active specification for openwell submersible pumpsets.
Official BIS standard title and catalog record designate IS 14220:2018 as First Revision replacing original 1994 edition.
BIS official catalog lists IS 8034:2018 (Third Revision) as the active specification for borehole submersible pumpsets.
Product Manual PM/IS 8034 confirms 2018 Third Revision replaces the 2002 Second Revision.

BIS LIMS scope list and Sectional Committee ETD 15 show IS 9283:2024 (Third Revision) as newly notified, replacing IS 9283:2013. Any transitional grace period for dual-running in public tenders is subject to procuring entity discretion and is not a universal statutory exemption.
Replaced by IS 9283:2024 Third Revision as listed in official BIS gazetted updates.
BIS catalog confirms IS 9079:2018 (Third Revision) as current active standard for monoset agricultural pumps.
BIS catalog confirms IS 6595 (Part 1):2018 Third Revision as current active standard for horizontal centrifugal pumps for rural/agricultural use.
BIS catalog confirms IS 8472:2019 Second Revision as current active standard for regenerative pumps.
BIS portal lists IS 996:2009 Fourth Revision. While newer revisions are drafted under ETD 15, official gazette cessation of the 2009 edition remains unverified.
Notified under statutory DPIIT Quality Control Order S.O. 167(E) as active standard for line operated three phase surface induction motors.
